faq.q: Where do Cloverdale townhomes under $1.2M actually sit?
faq.a: The band is a filter over the whole Cloverdale community (the Clayton, Cloverdale and Serpentine sub-areas); on the page text read for this file, the feed's cards were labelled Clayton, in the Clayton Heights plan neighbourhoods built out under the East Clayton (2003) and West Clayton (2015) NCPs.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Cloverdale townhome?
faq.a: School District 36, address-based. Cloverdale-area schools confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Katzie, Hazelgrove, Don Christian, Martha Currie and A J McLellan elementaries, and Lord Tweedsmuir, Clayton Heights and École Salish secondaries — check the exact address in the SD36 locator, because no Cloverdale locator result is on record in this program (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer use the PTT exemption on a Cloverdale townhome under $1.2M?
faq.a: Only at the band's lower end: the first time home buyers' program's full exemption requires a fair market value of $835,000 or less, with a partial exemption running to $860,000, and all the program's personal and property conditions must also be met — most of this band sits above those ceilings.
